+// Two currencies that happen to cancel numerically must still be rejected:
+// 100 EUR and -100 USD is not a balanced batch.
+func TestFlushRejectsCrossCurrencyCancellation(t *testing.T) {
+	j := NewJournal(&fakeSink{})
+	mustPost(t, j, "acct-1", 100, "EUR")
+	mustPost(t, j, "acct-2", -100, "USD")
+	if err := j.Flush(context.Background()); err == nil {
+		t.Fatal("cross-currency cancellation must not balance")
+	}
+}
